description:
Learn how to repair small holes in drywall caused by screws, wall anchors, and minor wall damage using spackling instead of drywall compound. In this quick drywall repair tip, Jeff shows the right way to prep screw holes, push in the damaged paper, fill the hole flush with spackle, and avoid making anchor holes bigger than they need to be.
For plastic drywall anchors, don’t pull the whole anchor out if you can avoid it. Break off the head, push the remaining anchor slightly into the wall, and fill the small dent with spackling for a cleaner one-coat repair.
This method is ideal for fixing small drywall holes before painting, repairing wall anchor damage, patching screw holes, and getting a smooth finish without multiple coats of joint compound.
